scenes.text: In 1901, divers pulled a lump of *rotten bronze* out of the sea.
It came from a Greek shipwreck, and it was *2,000 years old.*
Over *thirty bronze gears,* each one tiny and perfectly cut.
It tracked the *Moon,* predicted *eclipses,* and even timed the *Olympic Games.*
Nothing this advanced appears again for over *a thousand years.*
Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
